title: Неограничительные придаточные: запятые и which ко всему предложению

why: Неограничительное (добавочное) придаточное даёт дополнительную информацию, без которой предложение и так понятно. В русском такие обороты тоже выделяются запятыми ("мой брат, который живёт в Берлине"), но в английском правила строже: нельзя использовать that, нельзя пропускать who / which. Отдельная ловушка: which может относиться ко всему предыдущему предложению ("..., что означало...").
formation: • человек: , who + глагол ,  (my boss, who lives in Boston, ...)
• предмет: , which + глагол ,  (my laptop, which is old, ...)
• принадлежность: , whose + существительное  (Anna, whose brother works here, ...)
• место / время: , where ... / , when ...  (Lviv, where I studied, ...)
• с предлогом (формально): , to whom / with which ...  (my manager, with whom I work, ...)
• ко всему предложению: основная мысль , which + глагол  (He lost his job, which was a shock.)
Если придаточное стоит в середине, запятая ставится с обеих сторон.
usage: 1. Дополнительная информация о человеке или предмете, который и так понятен (имя, my + существительное, единственный в своём роде). (Мой брат, который живёт в Берлине, дизайнер. — My brother, who lives in Berlin, is a designer.)
2. Which относится ко всему предложению. (Сервер упал, а это значит, что мы потеряли данные. — The server crashed, which meant we lost the data.)
3. Where / when / whose для места, времени, принадлежности. (Мы были в Праге, где вырос мой муж. — We visited Prague, where my husband grew up.)

4. Разница в смысле. Без запятых мы выбираем часть группы, с запятыми говорим обо всей группе. (The developers who work remotely are happier = только удалённые. The developers, who work remotely, are happier = все они удалённые.)
signalWords: Запятые в письме и пауза в речи; имена собственные (Kyiv, Mr. Brown); my / our + существительное; весь контекст понятен и без придаточного.
mistakes: ✗ My car, that is old, still works → ✓ My car, which is old, still works (that после запятой нельзя)
✗ He lost his job, that was a shock → ✓ ..., which was a shock (which ко всей мысли)
✗ Mike, I met yesterday, is a tester → ✓ Mike, whom / who I met yesterday, is a tester (местоимение нельзя опускать)
✗ The Eiffel Tower which is in Paris is famous → ✓ The Eiffel Tower, which is in Paris, is famous (нужны запятые)
✗ It rained all day, what ruined our trip → ✓ ..., which ruined our trip (what не используется)
remember: Есть запятая — нет that и нельзя пропустить who / which; "что" про всю ситуацию — это , which.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте who, whom, which, whose, where или when

items.prompt: My manager, ___ lives in Boston, is visiting us.
items.answer: who

items.prompt: The new office, ___ is near the river, has a gym.
items.answer: which

items.prompt: Anna, ___ brother works at Google, is my neighbor.
items.answer: whose

items.prompt: We stayed in Lisbon, ___ my parents got married.
items.answer: where

items.prompt: I'll never forget 2020, ___ we all worked from home.
items.answer: when

items.prompt: The project, ___ started in March, is almost finished.
items.answer: which

items.prompt: Our CTO, ___ I really respect, is leaving.
items.answer: whom / who

items.prompt: She didn't answer, ___ annoyed me.
items.answer: which

exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения с помощью неограничительного придаточного

items.prompt: My sister is a doctor. She lives in Toronto.
items.answer: My sister, who lives in Toronto, is a doctor.

items.prompt: Python is easy to learn. It is very popular.
items.answer: Python, which is very popular, is easy to learn.

items.prompt: We visited Prague. My wife grew up there.
items.answer: We visited Prague, where my wife grew up.

items.prompt: Tom is my teammate. His laptop broke yesterday.
items.answer: Tom, whose laptop broke yesterday, is my teammate.

items.prompt: The bus was late. This made me miss the meeting.
items.answer: The bus was late, which made me miss the meeting.

items.prompt: Mr. Brown is our biggest client. I met him in Paris.
items.answer: Mr. Brown, whom I met in Paris, is our biggest client. / Mr. Brown, who I met in Paris, is our biggest client.

items.prompt: The website crashed. It was updated an hour ago.
items.answer: The website, which was updated an hour ago, crashed.

items.prompt: I love July. The weather is perfect then.
items.answer: I love July, when the weather is perfect.

exercises.instruction: Расставьте запятые. Если запятые не нужны, напишите OK

items.prompt: My brother who lives in Berlin is a designer.
items.answer: My brother, who lives in Berlin, is a designer.

items.prompt: The people who work here are very friendly.
items.answer: OK

items.prompt: Lviv which is in western Ukraine is a lovely city.
items.answer: Lviv, which is in western Ukraine, is a lovely city.

items.prompt: The book that I borrowed was great.
items.answer: OK

items.prompt: She failed the test which surprised nobody.
items.answer: She failed the test, which surprised nobody.

items.prompt: The restaurant where we had dinner was expensive.
items.answer: OK

items.prompt: I called Steve whose number I found online.
items.answer: I called Steve, whose number I found online.

items.prompt: We moved to Denver where the cost of living is lower.
items.answer: We moved to Denver, where the cost of living is lower.

exercises.instruction: Найдите ошибку и перепишите предложение правильно

items.prompt: My laptop, that is two years old, still works fine.
items.answer: My laptop, which is two years old, still works fine.

items.prompt: He passed the exam, that surprised everyone.
items.answer: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.

items.prompt: Mike, I met yesterday, is a tester.
items.answer: Mike, whom I met yesterday, is a tester. / Mike, who I met yesterday, is a tester.

items.prompt: The Eiffel Tower which is in Paris is very famous.
items.answer: The Eiffel Tower, which is in Paris, is very famous.

items.prompt: It rained all week, what ruined our trip.
items.answer: It rained all week, which ruined our trip.

items.prompt: My boss, who his wife is a lawyer, is very busy.
items.answer: My boss, whose wife is a lawyer, is very busy.

items.prompt: We stayed in Rome, that is my favorite city.
items.answer: We stayed in Rome, which is my favorite city.

items.prompt: Our CEO, with who I work closely, is very kind.
items.answer: Our CEO, with whom I work closely, is very kind.

items.prompt: Мой брат, который живёт в Берлине, работает программистом.
items.answer: My brother, who lives in Berlin, works as a programmer. / My brother, who lives in Berlin, is a programmer.

items.prompt: Сервер упал, а это значит, что мы потеряли данные.
items.answer: The server crashed, which meant we lost the data.

items.prompt: Мы были в Лондоне, где я раньше жил.
items.answer: We were in London, where I used to live.

items.prompt: Анна, чья сестра работает у нас, сейчас в отпуске.
items.answer: Anna, whose sister works for us, is on vacation now.

items.prompt: Он опоздал, что меня разозлило.
items.answer: He was late, which made me angry. / He was late, which annoyed me.

items.prompt: Наш офис, который находится в центре города, сегодня закрыт.
items.answer: Our office, which is in the city center, is closed today.

items.prompt: Мой начальник, с которым я работаю пять лет, уходит.
items.answer: My boss, with whom I have worked for five years, is leaving. / My boss, who I have worked with for five years, is leaving.

items.prompt: Я люблю осень, когда в парке так красиво.
items.answer: I love autumn, when the park is so beautiful.
